review_notes.note: RAG 文獻指出，不明原因的體重變化、食慾不振、噁心、嘔吐等症狀可能與多種潛在疾病相關，包括腎臟、肝臟或心臟疾病，以及過敏反應。應優先詢問這些症狀以評估嚴重性。
RAG 文獻建議，在評估液體與營養改變時，應詢問患者的個人或家族心臟病史、藥物史，並進行完整的身體檢查，特別是生命體徵與血糖水平。

rag_sources.excerpt: results. The use of tumor marker measurement in pericardial fluid may be helpful in cytologically negative pericardial fluid. The interpretation of these tumor marker levels is similar to that in serum. Malignant pericardial effusion is associated with high levels of tumor markers. However, low levels of these markers do not exclude neoplastic involvement of the pericardial membrane. The cut-off of these markers in pericardial fluid is not yet clear at this point.
